articles.author: Christine Idzelis, Steve Goldstein, Jamie Chisholm, Nora Redmond
articles.title: Stock Market Today: Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq decline as tech stocks struggle and oil prices jump on threat of war resuming in Iran - MarketWatch
articles.description: The U.S stock market was under pressure Thursday, as investors monitored tensions in the Middle East and tech stocks struggled. The 2-year Treasury yield was rising as oil prices climbed and investors worried about the potential for another Fed rate hike in 2…
